risks.evidence: TowerMarkersLayer calls map-focus selection, selectedMapObject and selectTower for one click; Network mode toggles cluster membership and invalidates results.
risks.mitigation: A small explicit Inspect / Select-cells choice; edit modes (area draw/place/path endpoint) take priority. Inspector open must not mutate plan selection.

risks.evidence: drawerMode=inspector replaces ToolDrawer content and remembers one previousTool; changing tool clears selectedMapObject.
risks.mitigation: Separate right inspector state from active tool/drawer state; preserve both independently; Close clears only inspected entity.

risks.evidence: Actual rail/drawer widths leave 672px map corridor at 1440 and 526px with two panels at 1280.
risks.mitigation: Push only at 1600+; 1440 opposite-edge overlay; 1280/1024 replace drawer; 768/390 one bottom sheet. Validate with live map interaction.

risks.evidence: Inventory owns detailed cell fields and validation; current TowerInspector only shows identity/network/cluster/coordinates.
risks.mitigation: Read-only inspector; Edit in Inventory direct action; no duplicate form or update path.

risks.evidence: RF invalidation clears rendered analysis while retaining current result Run identity; sample payload may outlive its layer.
risks.mitigation: Keep exact source Run/freshness; show STALE with frozen snapshot only where retained, otherwise UNAVAILABLE; no silent recompute.

risks.evidence: selectedMapCellId is used for map Focus while selectedTower and selectedNetworkTowerIds affect planning.
risks.mitigation: Use distinct state and language for plan selection, map Focus, inspected entity, and selected Pareto solution.

risks.evidence: openSavedScenario clears Run focus but does not explicitly clear selectedMapObject before restoring a different Scenario.
risks.mitigation: Clear inspector identity before Project/Scenario switch; reject late async detail responses from the previous entity.

risks.evidence: Existing phone uses a full-width bottom ToolDrawer sheet and bottom stage rail.
risks.mitigation: Use the same single sheet host for tool chooser/drawer/inspector; only one open, explicit Back/Close and focus return.

risks.evidence: Concept 7I uses explicit dynamic imports for research, Experiments, Core Lab, Run History and Reports.
risks.mitigation: Inspector resolves existing loaded entity data; never mount unrelated lazy tools or trigger compute; keep RF Diagnostics subview chunks lazy.

risks.evidence: selectedSolutionId and exact selected optimization Run are already App/Results-owned; Pareto detail includes Apply and no recompute.
risks.mitigation: Keep Pareto selection/detail in Results, not inspector; exact source Run test remains required.

risks.evidence: Current MapInspector returns to previous tool; path profile and source Run links explicitly change tool.
risks.mitigation: Preserve the exact active tool/context and route only on explicit action; Back restores the prior tool state.

risks.evidence: Data calibration, RF Diagnostics validation, material and reflection outputs are isolated evidence workflows.
risks.mitigation: Inspector presents evidence only; calibration and model changes remain explicit actions in their owner workflow.

risks.evidence: ToolDrawer focuses heading on focusKey/open; map pointer clicks can be frequent.
risks.mitigation: Pointer inspection does not steal focus or announce hover; keyboard Inspect action moves focus to named inspector heading.

implementation_boundary: 8E must remain frontend orchestration/presentation only: no changes to RF requests, optimizer, Run/Report/Scenario domain schemas, artifact bytes/integrity, freshness rules, ProjectV2, data packs, backend APIs, routes, or global state framework.
